shared_elements: row of repeated abstract signs or blocks
justification: The strongest correspondence is the combination of schematic profile animals, especially long-necked birds, with horizontal registers of repeated geometric signs including chevron/triangle patterning. The biggest difference is that A is mainly a dense linear frieze of repeated signs and animals, while B presents larger separated animal figures and stacked scenes on a pillar-like surface, with no clearly matching single scene or figure-to-figure relationship.
